Deprecated: the MCP protocol is moving to sessionless, so this option will soon be removed and the connection scope will default to 'global'. For shared-server use cases, use the Atlas-Managed MCP server or build an authenticated library using the @mongodb-js/mcp-cli package. environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API. Default: http://127.0.0.1:27123 (enable "Non-encrypted (HTTP) Server" in plugin settings). Use https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the always-on HTTPS port (self-signed cert; pair with OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL=false).

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate on the Obsidian endpoint. Default false because the plugin uses a self-signed cert.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in flag for the command-palette pair (obsidian_list_commands + obsidian_execute_command). Off by default — Obsidian commands are opaque and can be destructive.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; backslashes read as slashes, repeated and trailing slashes and '.' segments dropped, and names normalized to Unicode NFC; an entry naming the vault root ('.') is rejected at startup. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault, or the read scope when reads are restricted; paths in OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS stay denied. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative paths withheld from reads and writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Wins over both allowlists; denied paths are left out of listings, search results, and tag counts. Unset = nothing denied. Example: 'private/,journal/therapy/'.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_DELETE_ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in delete confirmation. When true, obsidian_delete_note asks the user to confirm each delete through an elicitation round (the client must support elicitation), and HTTP startup requires a stateful session unless OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true disables the tool. Off by default — the delete runs on the first call, bounded by OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS and OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in flag for the command-palette pair (obsidian_list_commands + obsidian_execute_command). Off by default — Obsidian commands are opaque and can be destructive.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; backslashes read as slashes, repeated and trailing slashes and '.' segments dropped, and names normalized to Unicode NFC; an entry naming the vault root ('.') is rejected at startup. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault, or the read scope when reads are restricted; paths in OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS stay denied. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_DENY_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative paths withheld from reads and writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Wins over both allowlists; denied paths are left out of listings, search results, and tag counts. Unset = nothing denied. Example: 'private/,journal/therapy/'.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_DELETE_ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in delete confirmation. When true, obsidian_delete_note asks the user to confirm each delete through an elicitation round (the client must support elicitation), and HTTP startup requires a stateful session unless OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true disables the tool. Off by default — the delete runs on the first call, bounded by OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS and OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY.

environmentVariables.name: BASE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

environmentVariables.name: IGNORE_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of glob patterns for files to keep out of the index, each matched against the file's path relative to its root (e.g. '["plugs/**","**/*.draft.md"]').

environmentVariables.name: DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

environmentVariables.name: HF_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Hugging Face model download endpoint. Set this to a mirror URL when direct downloads are blocked (defaults to https://huggingface.co).

environmentVariables.name: MODEL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING
environmentVariables.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
environmentVariables.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

environmentVariables.name: STORE_IMAGES
environmentVariables.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).

environmentVariables.name: EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Embed each chunk together with its document title, which can help when passages don't restate the topic the title names (defaults to false). After changing it, use a new DB_PATH or delete the index and re-ingest.

environmentVariables.name: EMBED_HEADING_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Add section headings to chunk embeddings when they fit (defaults to false). Independent of EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX. Re-ingest documents after changing it.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_DTYPE
environmentVariables.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
environmentVariables.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD
environmentVariables.description: External reranker command template. Use {query} and {top} for query text and result count; unset disables reranking.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.
